outlet: VoteWA election results, Asotin County, August 4, 2026 primary
notes: Asotin County primary results (26 of 26 units, as of 2026-09-11): Sheriff Richards 3,016, Renzelman 2,913; County Commissioner District No. 3 counted in 7 of 7 units (Whitman 1,009); Rural EMS District No. 2 Proposition No. 1 (listed as 'Proposition No. 1') in 2 of 2 units, Yes 118, No 146; Clarkston EMS Excess Levy 8 of 8 units, Yes 785, No 516; unopposed Rynearson 4,610, McKay 4,904, Campbell 4,779, Liedkie 4,740, Steiner 4,794.
